notes: *up* and *away* are read as the English verbs' phrasal particles (rule 44) rather than as renderings of the ethical datives, which the ASV leaves unstated; both לְ prepositions and their suffixes are unrepresented (rules 22, 40).
יָפָתִי takes *fair one* headed on *fair*, the supplied generic completing the substantival adjective (rule 31), while the suffix keeps its own *my*.
